Instructions for Use
Device description: The Lumen SCS System is a spinal cord stimulation system. It is available in lengths from 12 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Lumen SCS System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
- Static magnetic field of 1.5 T or 3 T
- Maximum spatial gradient magnetic field of 1000-gauss/cm (10-T/m)
- At 1.5 T: B1+RMS of 3.6 µT or less; for MR scanners that do not report B1+rms, Whole-Body SAR ≤ 2 W/kg
- At 3 T: Maximum whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 1.5-W/kg; No more than 20 minutes of active scan time per session
- RF excitation: circularly polarized (CP) only
- Device configuration: Stimulation OFF
- Scan regions: Full body scanning is permitted (no exclusion zone)
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Lumen SCS System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 1.6 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
